_comment: Source of truth for CORRECTED map identity (CLAUDE.md §4.3). Phase-5 `mint` consults `overrides` BEFORE map_infos.json, because RMXP MapInfos editor names can be stale. `overrides` = map id -> {display_name, evidence}; mint reads ONLY this map. `reviewed` records identity questions checked against the wiki that need NO override, so they are not re-litigated. `orphans` = maps with no map_infos entry, pending disposition. `phase7_confirm` = ids to verify in the §9 #3 manual playthrough. Build-agent-maintained; arbitration is spoiler-free (location names / BGM asset / connection topology only). Wiki: https://pokemon-uranium.fandom.com/wiki/

66.evidence: CH10 first build (2026-10-23). map_infos name 'Burole Town(Gym)' — identity correct (map 60 cave-mouth door at (39,7) -> map 66; leader EV004 grants badge 2), override only normalizes the parenthetical. Same treatment as maps 50/67.

2.evidence: CH10 first build (2026-10-23). map_infos name 'Burole Town (PC)' — identity correct (map 60 door at (21,20) -> map 2; heal counter + PC), override normalizes to the map 68 spelling.

4.evidence: CH10 first build (2026-10-23). map_infos name 'Burole Town (Mart)' — identity correct (map 60 door at (22,45) -> map 4; pbPokemonMart), override normalizes to the map 67 spelling.

29.evidence: CH10 first build (2026-10-23). map_infos names maps 60, 29, 85 and 90 all bare 'Burole Town' (MAP_BUROLE_TOWN collides). Map 29 (40x20, tileset 19, parent 60) is entered from map 60 at (12,41) and holds two halves joined by internal warps plus four talk-to-battle trainers and a var107 win counter (reference/chapters/10-burole-town.md §2). Spoiler-free functional label.

90.evidence: CH10 first build (see map 29 for the collision). Maps 85 and 90 are single-room houses (20x15, tileset 19, parent 60). Numbered west-to-east by map-60 door X as maps 64/65 were: map 90's door is at (11,31), map 85's at (14,24), so map 90 = House 1.

85.evidence: CH10 first build (see maps 29 and 90). Map 85's map-60 door is at (14,24), east of map 90's (11,31), so map 85 = House 2.

9.evidence: CH11 disambiguation (2026-10-26). Maps 76 and 9 both carry the map_infos name 'Route 04'. Map 9 (20x15) is a pass-through gate: west door to Burole Town (map 60 (70,22)), east door to Route 4 (map 76 (18,102)). Map 76 keeps the plain name. Same treatment as map 1.

1.evidence: CH09 disambiguation (2026-10-22). Maps 59, 1 and 54 all carry the map_infos name 'Route 03'. Map 1 (20x15, child of 59) is a pass-through gate: doors from Route 3 at (87,8)/(88,8) and far doors to Burole Town (map 60). Map 59 keeps the plain name. Spoiler-free positional label.

54.evidence: CH09 disambiguation (see map 1). Map 54 (20x15, child of 59) is a single-room house entered from Route 3 at (31,26), with no other exit.

48.evidence: Pathfinder S4 floor disambiguation. Maps 48 and 49 share the map_infos name '\PN's house'. S1 warp trace (PATHFINDER_FINDINGS.md): map 49 has the street door to Moki Town => ground floor (1F, player spawn); map 48 is reachable only via the in-house stairs from 49 => upper floor (2F). The RMXP MapInfos `order` field (48=9, 49=10) is editor tree order, NOT floor order, and would mislabel them.

49.evidence: Pathfinder S4 floor disambiguation (see map 48). Map 49 = ground floor: it owns the street door to Moki Town (map 32) and is the player spawn (URANIUM_START_MAP=49 @7,7).

65.evidence: Map Walker batch disambiguation. Maps 64 and 65 share the generic map_infos name 'Moki Town' (both are buildings with parent_id 32). Topology: Moki Town (map 32) has a door at (24,42) -> map 65 and a door at (43,31) -> map 64. Numbered west-to-east by door X (65 door x=24 < 64 door x=43), so map 65 = House 1. Spoiler-free positional label; refine to a specific building identity later if desired.

64.evidence: Map Walker batch disambiguation (see map 65). Map 64's Moki Town door is at (43,31), east of map 65's (24,42), so map 64 = House 2.

50.evidence: Slice-1 interior expansion (SLICE1_TODO #13, 2026-07-13). map_infos name is 'Moki Town (professor lab)' — identity correct (Moki Town door at (17,11) -> map 50; lab machine + professor NPCs), override only normalizes the parenthetical for display/constant minting.

172.evidence: Slice-1 interior expansion floor disambiguation (SLICE1_TODO #13). Maps 172 and 89 share the map_infos name 'Moki Town (Theo)'. Map 172 owns the street door from Moki Town (56,42) => ground floor; map 89 is reachable only via the in-house warp from 172 (EV3 -> 89 @4,3) => upper floor. Mirrors the 48/49 pattern (MapInfos order/parent fields are editor tree order, not floor order).

89.evidence: Slice-1 interior expansion floor disambiguation (see map 172). Map 89 has no street door; its only exit warps back to map 172 (EV2 -> 172 @11,3).

67.evidence: CH03 scope pass (2026-08-12). map_infos name is 'Kevlar Town(Pokemart)' — identity correct (map 31 door at (37,14) -> map 67; pbPokemonMart at EV1), override only normalizes the parenthetical for display/constant minting. Same treatment as map 50.

68.evidence: CH03 scope pass (2026-08-12). map_infos name is 'Kevlar Town(Pokemon Center)' — identity correct (map 31 door at (20,12) -> map 68; pbSetPokemonCenter at the counter EV1), override only normalizes the parenthetical.

73.evidence: CH03 scope pass (2026-08-12), user-approved. map_infos names map 73 'Kevlar Town', colliding with map 31 (the outdoor hub). Map 73 is one physical map holding four separate interiors: map 31's four doors land at four distinct x-regions inside it (x~5 bike repair shop, x~24 an apartment, x~44 berry boutique, x~64 a house). No single building name is correct, so the label is the collective. Not split into four maps — map 73 is one map and we have no map-splitting pass.

19.evidence: CH03 scope pass (2026-08-12), user-approved; SUPERSEDES this map's former `reviewed` verdict, which called it the Kevlar->Nowtoch through-cave. Two independent refutations: (a) warp trace — map 19's only code-201 command anywhere is EV7 (11,30) -> map 31 (13,7), the same tile its entrance sits on, and no warp in the corpus reaches map 19 from any map but 31, so it cannot be a through-route; the real through-cave is maps 36/37 via the map31<->map35 connection seam. (b) The wiki's own Passage Cave page carries a 'Grott-Hole' subsection stating the grott-hole does not connect to the through cave; its nav infobox (north=Nowtoch City, south=Route 2) describes maps 36/37 only. Name also disambiguates the engine dir from maps 36/37 (since 2026-08-31 labelled 'Passage Cave 1F'/'2F' -- see their overrides).

36.evidence: CH05 scope pass (2026-08-31), operator ruling; SUPERSEDES this map's former `reviewed` verdict ('CORRECT -- no override'). That verdict left maps 36 and 37 both named 'Passage Cave', which is right about identity but not mintable: `mint` fails loud on the second of them (map 37 -> MAP_PASSAGE_CAVE collides with already-minted map 36), and it was CH05's first blocker. Maps 36/37 are the two floors of the Kevlar->Nowtoch through-cave (map 19 is the separate Grott-Hole offshoot, see its override). Map 36 is the entrance floor: it carries the seam to the overland and the warps up to map 37. Floor labels are the operator's call, not derived. -> MAP_PASSAGE_CAVE_1F, dir PassageCave1F.

37.evidence: CH05 scope pass (2026-08-31), operator ruling; SUPERSEDES this map's former `reviewed` verdict (see map 36 for the collision that forced it). Map 37 is the inner/upper floor -- reachable only from map 36, and the floor whose four sideways staircases are its only vertical traversal. -> MAP_PASSAGE_CAVE_2F, dir PassageCave2F. No engine/data/maps/ entry existed for either map when this was decided, so nothing downstream was pinned to the old name.

44.evidence: CH06 first build (2026-10-06), operator ruling (names from reference/chapters/06-nowtoch-city.md §2). Maps 44 and 45 share the map_infos name 'Nowtoch City(Metro)', so `mint` failed loud (map 45 -> MAP_NOWTOCH_CITY_METRO collides with map 44). Map 44 is the street-level room: entered from Nowtoch City (map 40), holds the ticket kiosk and region-map viewer, and is the parent (parent_id) of map 45. -> MAP_NOWTOCH_CITY_METRO_STATION.

45.evidence: CH06 first build (2026-10-06), operator ruling (see map 44). Map 45 is the child map of 44 (parent_id 44), reachable only through it, and holds the departure-menu event (event 3) that warps to other cities' metro maps. -> MAP_NOWTOCH_CITY_METRO_PLATFORM.

46.evidence: CH06 first build (2026-10-06), operator ruling (names from 06-nowtoch-city.md §2). map_infos names maps 40, 46 and 47 all bare 'Nowtoch City' (MAP_NOWTOCH_CITY collides). Map 46 is an indoor canvas (60x40, interior tileset 19, parent_id 40) reached from several separate doors on map 40 with internal self-warps — several buildings/floors packed on one RMXP map. Whether it should be split is open (06-nowtoch-city.md §6.3). -> MAP_NOWTOCH_CITY_INTERIORS_1.

47.evidence: CH06 first build (2026-10-06), operator ruling (names from 06-nowtoch-city.md §2; see map 46 for the collision). Map 47 is a 35x15 two-room interior (tileset 19, parent_id 40) reached from map 40's key-checked door (event 17) and event 66; it hosts the event that sets FLAG_GYM1. -> MAP_NOWTOCH_CITY_LEADER_HOUSE.

7.evidence: Connects map 76 (Route 04) <-> map 142 (Route 05). Wiki: Comet Cave = the Route 4<->Route 5 dungeon (Burole/Amatree Town -> Rochfale Town). Topology matches the label. The 'PU-Passage Cave' BGM shared across maps 7/10/96 AND 19/36/37 is a reused cave-music asset, not an identity signal. REFUTES the Phase-3 V4 hypothesis (map 7 = Passage Cave), which over-indexed on that shared BGM.

10.evidence: Comet Cave inner floor; connects map 96 + map 142 (Route 05).

96.evidence: Comet Cave inner floor; connects maps 7 and 10.

19.evidence: WRONG, kept as a record of the mistake. This verdict read map 19 as the Kevlar -> Nowtoch through-cave; the warp trace and the wiki's Grott-Hole subsection both say map 19 is an isolated offshoot that dead-ends back into map 31, and the through-cave is maps 36/37. Full reasoning in the override entry. Original text: 'Hangs off map 31 (Kevlar Town). Wiki: Passage Cave = the Kevlar Town -> Nowtoch City dungeon (the Route 2 rockslide alternative). Label matches topology; same shared cave BGM as Comet Cave.'

36.evidence: Kept as a record. The verdict accepted the bare map_infos name 'Passage Cave' for both floors; correct as identity, but two maps cannot share one MAP_* constant, so it blocked CH05's mint. Superseded by the CH05 floor disambiguation. Original text: 'Passage Cave floor (parent of map 37). Same cave system as map 19.'

37.evidence: Kept as a record. The verdict accepted the bare map_infos name 'Passage Cave' for both floors; correct as identity, but two maps cannot share one MAP_* constant, so it blocked CH05's mint. Superseded by the CH05 floor disambiguation. Original text: 'Passage Cave inner floor (child of map 36).'
